title: Replace Price field with Unit Type dropdown and implement dynamic quantity inputs

requirements.text: In the AdminProductForm component, replace the fixed Price input field with a Unit Type dropdown. The dropdown must have exactly four options: Kg, Gram, Packet, and Piece.

quotes: In the 'Add Product' form, replace the fixed Price field with a 'Unit Type' dropdown. It should have options: Kg, Gram, Packet, and Piece.

acceptanceCriteria: The Price field is removed from the Add Product form
A Unit Type dropdown is displayed in its place
The dropdown contains exactly four options: Kg, Gram, Packet, and Piece
The form validation requires a unit type selection before submission

requirements.text: Update the backend Product type to include a unitType field (Kg, Gram, Packet, or Piece) instead of or in addition to the price field. Modify the addProduct function to accept and store the unit type.

quotes: In the 'Add Product' form, replace the fixed Price field with a 'Unit Type' dropdown.

acceptanceCriteria: Product type includes unitType field with variant type for Kg, Gram, Packet, Piece
addProduct function accepts unitType parameter
Products are stored with their unit type in stable storage

requirements.text: On the shop page (ProductCard and CartDrawer), for products with unit type 'Kg' or 'Gram', display a text input field where customers can enter custom weight values. Accept inputs like '100g', '0.5kg', '1.5kg', '250g' and parse them correctly.

quotes: If I select Kg, the customer should be able to type custom weight (like 100g or 0.5kg) on the shop page.

acceptanceCriteria: Products with Kg or Gram unit type show a weight input field instead of +/- buttons
Input accepts formats: '100g', '0.5kg', '1.5kg', '250g'
Weight values are parsed and converted to a consistent unit for cart storage
Invalid inputs show validation errors
Cart displays the custom weight entered by the customer

requirements.text: On the shop page (ProductCard and CartDrawer), for products with unit type 'Packet' or 'Piece', display only '+' and '-' quantity buttons for incrementing/decrementing whole number quantities. Hide the custom weight input for these unit types.

quotes: If I select Packet, the customer should only see '+' and '-' quantity buttons.

acceptanceCriteria: Products with Packet or Piece unit type show only +/- quantity buttons
Quantities can only be whole numbers (1, 2, 3, etc.)
No weight input field is shown for these unit types
Cart displays the integer quantity for Packet/Piece products

requirements.text: Update the cart data structure to support both quantity-based items (Packet, Piece) and weight-based items (Kg, Gram). Modify the backend addToCart and related cart functions to handle both types correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Cart items store either quantity (for Packet/Piece) or weight (for Kg/Gram)
Backend addToCart function accepts both quantity and weight parameters
Cart retrieval returns the correct type of measurement for each item

requirements.text: Update all product display components (ProductCard, AdminProductList, BillTemplate) to show the unit type instead of or alongside the price. Ensure billing and checkout flows correctly calculate totals based on unit type and quantity/weight.
acceptanceCriteria: Product cards display unit type (Kg, Gram, Packet, Piece)
Admin product list shows unit type for each product
Bills display quantity with unit (e.g., '0.5 Kg', '3 Packet')
Checkout page calculates subtotals correctly for both weight and quantity items

constraints: Do not modify immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Preserve existing cart functionality and authentication flow
nonGoals: Adding pricing per unit (price will be handled separately)
Implementing unit conversion between Kg and Gram
Adding new unit types beyond the four specified
